title: Decision Matrix Entry
description: One row of a Decision Matrix (examples/decision_matrix.md). The AI-generated analysis populates every field except 'status' and any post-hoc approval fields; 'decision_owner' must always be a named human role, never the model itself.

trigger.description: The condition or evidence that raised this decision.

options.description: At least two real options, including an explicit 'do nothing / continue monitoring' option where applicable.

recommended_option.description: Which option is recommended and why - a recommendation, not a decision already made.

decision_owner.description: A named human role accountable for this decision (e.g. 'Checkout Engineering Lead'). Must never be 'AI', 'the model', or similar.

approval_deadline.description: ISO 8601 timestamp or a relative deadline description.

fallback.description: What happens if the deadline passes without a decision (must escalate, never auto-execute).
